phase: Phase 6I-MR — Live-State Utility Model Revision, Regime-Robust Ranking, and Fresh-Holdout Promotion Gate

baseline_tests.original_command: pytest -q tests/test_phase6f_revision.py tests/test_phase6g_live_solver.py tests/test_phase6h_calibration.py tests/test_decoder.py tests/test_feasibility.py
baseline_tests.revision_1_2_command: pytest -q tests/test_phase6f_revision.py tests/test_phase6g_live_solver.py tests/test_phase6h_calibration.py tests/test_decoder.py tests/test_feasibility.py tests/test_phase5c_search.py tests/test_phase6i_mr_candidate_roles.py tests/test_phase6i_mr_instances.py tests/test_phase6i_mr_pilot.py

instance_suite.size_choice: minimum compliant 18 per split; chosen over preferred 27 because the declared single-GPU five-seed R11 protocol is already compute-intensive, and size may not be reduced after R10 access

candidate_bank_contract.semantics: 24 deterministic generation rules followed by target-set deduplication
candidate_bank_contract.clarification: candidate_trials=8 is the repair/decoder trial count and is not the proposal-bank size
candidate_bank_contract.revision_1_2_eight_candidate_interpretat: the instruction's all-eight audit is implemented as a fixed top-eight audit layer while a smaller true-full-bank subset evaluates every deduplicated arm; neither layer changes production proposal semantics

search.checkpoint_loading: load once per GPU worker; exclude consistently from run budget and report separately

pilot.label_timing: snapshot during trajectory; select and decode forced candidates only after the trajectory has ended
pilot.trajectory_outcome_blindness: forced outcomes, timing, and RNG cannot change the source trajectory

forced_candidate_roles.diverse_rule: maximize minimum Jaccard distance from already selected target sets, then raw frozen score descending, then target_set_id ascending
forced_candidate_roles.duplicate_replacement: scan the same preregistered outcome-blind ordering for the first unseen target set; record an explicit shortfall if fewer than four unique target sets exist
forced_candidate_roles.fallback_definition: the selected ALNS_RELATED_FALLBACK role in the same state
forced_candidate_roles.rank_ties: minimum rank with decoded utility descending and target_set_id ascending

full_collection.sampling: fixed normalized wall-progress quantiles within EARLY, MIDDLE, LATE; nearest unique snapshot with deterministic tie break
full_collection.r10_use: evaluate every preregistered frozen candidate/threshold combination exactly once; never refit

candidate_truncation_audit.purpose: diagnose four-candidate label truncation without changing the frozen production bank

top_eight_subset.stage_assignment: six EARLY at 0.15, six MIDDLE at 0.50, six LATE at 0.85 by sorted scale-CF-cell_replicate index modulo three
top_eight_subset.candidate_rule: union the four forced roles with frozen-score order, then append highest-score unseen target sets until exactly eight unique targets or exhaust the bank

true_full_bank_subset.candidate_rule: evaluate every unique target set from the frozen 24-rule deduplicated bank

remaining_operations.reason: the current complete-schedule local-search representation has zero remaining operations at every decision state

continuation_diagnostic.states: one state nearest 0.15, 0.50, and 0.85 progress for each of the nine cells
continuation_diagnostic.branch_metric: median within-state Spearman and top1 agreement across state-seed groups

training_data.negative_transfer_rule: MIXED is ineligible if its three-seed mean R10 Spearman is more than 0.02 below R09_ONLY, its worst-seed Spearman is more than 0.05 below R09_ONLY, or it introduces a scale sign reversal

U2_H.description: U2 plus a separate fixed-horizon continuation-value head
U2_H.gate_rule: probability eligibility, rank by continuation value, require immediate utility >= 0 and continuation value >= selected continuation threshold

U3.activation: best grouped-OOF R09 U1/U2 overall per-instance utility Spearman < 0.20 or any scale mean Spearman < 0
U3.description: limited last relation block, final action projection, and utility adaptation

training_seed_robustness.family_artifact_rule: shared frozen encoder with arithmetic mean of the three seed-specific normalized utility-head outputs; all three heads are retained

eligibility.scale_sign_stability: at least two of three seeds non-negative in every scale and no seed below -0.10 in any scale

objective.listwise: ListNet cross entropy over all forced candidates in a state
objective.listwise_temperature: R09 median positive within-state utility standard deviation, lower-clipped at 0.001, then frozen
objective.cross_state_target: divide immediate relative utility by R09 p99 absolute utility and clip to [-1, 1]

contrastive_branch.activation: frozen-embedding grouped-OOF linear-probe pairwise accuracy < 0.55 and raw normalized-context probe accuracy >= 0.60

live_policy.probability_calibration: reuse frozen Phase6H Platt mapping when score head is bitwise frozen; otherwise fit on R09 only
live_policy.decision: filter candidates by probability threshold and support, select maximum revised utility with raw-score and target-set-ID tie breaks, then require the selected utility threshold; otherwise use frozen ALNS fallback
live_policy.support_guard: R09-fitted finite/range validity for all required context features; no R10/R11-fitted quantile

r09_threshold_constraints.low_coverage_rule: allowed when forced evaluation shows abstention is non-harmful and no scale solver collapse is present

r10_solver_translation.instances: the nine C02 R10 instances, one per scale-CF cell
r10_solver_translation.pass: 100% feasibility, aggregate revised-vs-ALNS relative makespan <= +0.01, no scale mean worse than +0.03, no instance worse than +0.075, and intervention/fallback replay integrity complete
r10_solver_translation.failure_action: stop with MODEL_REVISION; no R10 retuning and no R11 access

r11_protocol.primary_paired_unit: instance mean over five matched seeds
r11_protocol.budget: 2N wall-clock seconds for ALNS and both CSG-NI policies
r11_protocol.low_count_support_aware_exception: when selected count is below 200, require at least 120 forced-evaluated predicted-abstained actions in that scale, mean best forced utility <= 0 or no positive lift over fallback, grouped-bootstrap upper bound <= 0.0025, and solver non-inferiority to ALNS on that scale
r11_protocol.coverage_imbalance_exception: a ratio above 8 is allowed only with the low-coverage abstention evidence and no scale quality collapse; otherwise it fails
r11_protocol.forced_diagnostic_rule: fixed progress quantiles evaluated post-trajectory with the same four outcome-blind roles

statistics.wilcoxon: exact one-sided paired Wilcoxon on instance means; report statistic, p-value, direction, zero handling

promotion_gates.coverage_gate: support-aware count/forced-abstention/no-collapse rule from r11_protocol; no universal minimum intervention percentage
promotion_gates.catastrophic_collapse: any scale or CF-group mean relative makespan worse than ALNS by more than 0.02, or any instance mean worse by more than 0.05
promotion_gates.efficiency_gate: at least one strong advantage without final-quality loss

runtime_fairness.forbidden_claim: hardware-independent neural solver speed superiority from raw wall-clock alone

decision_logic.MODEL_REVISION: correctness and solver non-inferiority pass but at least one reliability or efficiency gate fails
decision_logic.HOLD: correctness, leakage integrity, feasibility, or aggregate solver stability fails materially
